title: Changelog: everything coming in the next update.
summary: Every change made since 24 November, sorted by topic. They are being tested now and will reach the public server with the next update.

groups.title: New features
changes: Day and night: a game day lasts 4 real hours, with 2 hours of daylight and 2 of night, and the sky brightens and darkens slowly at dawn and dusk. Say !time to see the game hour.

Hunting night: from 19:00 to 05:00 game time, monsters give 25% more experience and loot and respawn 25% faster, but wild monsters also hit 10% harder. The server announces when the night starts and ends.

Bounty on player killers: whoever kills a player unjustly pays 100 gold per own level, taken from the bank or the backpack. That gold becomes a bounty on the killer's head, and whoever kills them collects it in the bank. Say !bounty to see the 10 biggest bounties.

Exploration chests: one hidden chest in each region (Thais, Carlin, Kazordoon, Ab'Dendriel, Edron, Darashia, Venore, Ankrahmun, Rookgaard and Port Hope). Whoever finds one picks a permanent bonus for the character: gold, mana or health.

groups.title: Gameplay
changes: Hunting fatigue: hunting the same creature for a long time slowly lowers the experience it gives, 1% every 20 kills, down to at most 40% less. Fatigue wears off with time, and !fatigue shows which creatures are tiring you. Changing hunting spots keeps your experience at full.
Respawn follows the number of players online: with up to 10 players it stays normal, and it gets faster as more players join, up to twice as fast with 150 online.
Classic light: the lighting works like in 7.4 again, and torches last twice as long.
The Skills window shows how much health and mana you regenerate and where it comes from: food and exploration chests.
Your character is saved automatically every 5 minutes, and also when you close a trade or send a parcel, so much less progress is lost if the server goes down.
Bot detection: the server spots automated play and warns the staff.

groups.title: Economy
changes: Gold now drops at the original 1x rate, like in 7.4.

NPC prices follow the market: when players sell a lot of the same item to NPCs, its price drops 1% for every 20 units sold on the server, down to half the price, and slowly recovers over the following hours. The trade window always shows the current price.
House rent is now weekly, at a quarter of the monthly price. If you can't pay, you get a warning each day for 7 days; after that you lose the house and your items go to your depot.
Mailbox: a parcel or letter without a valid label (an existing character and town) is refused and stays with you.

groups.title: Fixes
changes: Fixes for known server crashes and abuses, such as bags nested inside bags without limit, containers above capacity and creatures removed in the middle of combat.
Reports (Ctrl+R): only the staff can close another player's report, and the report of a player who logs out is cancelled.
!frags shows the correct weekly and monthly counts.
The server keeps accepting logins when many players connect at the same time.
The rent warning stops as soon as the rent is paid, and bounty gold always reaches the player who collects it.
The server comes back on its own right after the daily server save.

groups.title: Client
changes: Smoother walking with high ping: your next step starts as soon as the server confirms the previous one, and the server sends game data without waiting.
Widescreen: when you log in, the map already appears at the right width, without flashing the classic 15x11 view.
Closing a chat channel no longer causes an error, and item descriptions with charges no longer repeat the final period.

groups.title: Removed
changes: The Bosstiary tab of the Game Wiki.
Drinking water no longer restores mana, and the Water line is gone from the Skills window.

paragraphs: Everything on this list is already running on our test server and will reach the public server with the next update.
Found a bug or have an idea? Tell us on Discord: discord.gg/CVneyh53mZ

title: Trade space warnings, longer food and water, and the Game Wiki.
summary: Changes that are already live on the public server since 24 November.

groups.title: Gameplay
changes: Water and food last up to 1 hour, with the time left shown in the Food and Water lines of the Skills window.
Experience and skill bonuses are back, together with the achievement and Bestiary bonuses.
The labyrinth and the lever of the original map work again like in 7.4.

groups.title: Economy
changes: The NPC trade window shows your capacity and warns you when a purchase won't fit in your weight or backpack, or when your change would fall to the floor.

groups.title: Client
changes: Game Wiki (in development): a book inside the client with Bestiary, Itempedia, Hunting Guide and Bosstiary.

paragraphs: These changes have been on the public server since 24 November. You only need to open the launcher to get them.

title: The public server is back, with a fresh start.
summary: The online world was rebuilt with a new database. Create your account on this site and download launcher v78 to play.
changes: New server and new database: accounts from the old server no longer exist, so please register again.
Account sign-up and My account work again on this site.
Launcher v78 connects to the new server and keeps the client updated automatically.
The game database is backed up every day.
paragraphs: Open Create account, choose your account number, character and password, then download launcher v78 on the same page. Extract it and open AntigasLauncher.exe.
Questions, bugs or ideas? Join the community on Discord: discord.gg/CVneyh53mZ

title: Friendlier NPCs, the original 7.4 map and a lighter client.
summary: Talking and trading with NPCs is easier, the world is back to the original 7.4 map, and the client is lighter and smoother to play.
changes: New NPC trade window: say hi, then trade, and pick items in a grid.
A chat balloon above NPCs: click it to say hi.
Right-clicking an NPC now greets it instead of attacking.
NPCs have a blue health bar, so they stand out from monsters.
Drinking water gives +1 mana every 10 seconds for 1 hour.
The map is back to the original 7.4: trainers, Yalahar, custom islands, the arena and horses were removed.
New minimap with markers for temples, banks, shops, quests and stairs.
The client now comes only in the OpenGL version (Antigas_gl.exe); the DirectX version was removed.
Widescreen fix and smoother walking when your ping is high.
The Discord button in the client opens our new community server.
paragraphs: These changes are in launcher v78 for the public server and in the localhost package local-test-v2.
Coming soon: a Game Wiki book inside the client, with Bestiary, Itempedia and a Hunting Guide.

title: Server and Windows client, ready for localhost.
summary: Download the complete package to explore Rookgaard and test your own changes in a separate local world.
changes: Server, test database and Windows .exe client in one package.
Tibia74-Local.exe prepares the world and opens the game; closing the game preserves its progress.
Normal demo account: 2 / local123, character Local Adventurer.
paragraphs: Requires Docker Desktop with Linux containers and internet for the first setup. The Windows client is already included.
Build, login, map entry, client movement and saved position after restart were validated. This is a test release; not every quest or game system has been fully tested.

title: Tibia 7.4 — A classic rpg version.
summary: Previously Antigas, the project now shares its code, development story and credits with the community on GitHub.
changes: New project name and public source repository.
README with the story behind the server and paths for players and contributors.
Original copyright notices and third-party licenses preserved.
paragraphs: The server was born from a dream of sharing adventures, exploration and good memories with the community. The project continues to evolve with its players and contributors.

This is an independent project with custom systems, inspired by Tibia. Credits include Alejandro Mujica, the OpenTibia and OTClient communities, and rxi. Tibia was created by CipSoft; this project is not affiliated with it.
